title: Why Women Need Love
paragraphs: When God took the male from the male, He made some rebuilding so that it could become a receiver. If you study the nature of women, you will find that they have no room to give. I was created for this. Oh, ladies, listen to me. This is absolutely fantastic. Woman was created for no other reason than to receive. It receives. It receives. It receives. Give them everything. Give them everything. Give them everything.

More love, money, attention, care, appreciation, affection, clothes, houses, shoes, shirts, more and more. Receiver. I have finished speaking with you. Hallelujah. I say Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now remember, in order for the giver to be complete, the receiver must be exactly the same as the giver. That is why God could not return to dust. Did you know that it has been scientifically proven that every cell in your body contains chromosomes and DNA to create an exact copy of you?

The Hebrew word that you are translating as "rib" is not a rib. It simply means "part". God produced the first cloned copy because it had to be exactly like the giver. Therefore, a woman is designed only to be loved. It was built solely to receive. That is why when it is taken from a woman, her functions are disrupted. Come on, men. Write that in capital letters. That is why the Bible never tells a woman to love a man, but rather commands a man to love his wife.
